canonicalSummary: Spicebomb Extreme by Viktor&Rolf is a 2015 men's Eau de Parfum created by Carlos Benaim and Jean-Christophe Hérault. It is classified as a Woody Spicy Amber fragrance. The top notes open with lavender, black pepper, and saffron; the heart centres on cinnamon and cumin; the base is built on tobacco accord, vanilla, bourbon, woody amber, and cistus. It is described as an intensified and darker evolution of the original Spicebomb (2012 EdT). All findings in this dossier concern the reference fragrance only and do not constitute evidence about Maison Skye & Rose's inspired formulation.
